create_aot_function: create a compiled function that traces forward and backward graphs and partitions them for separate compilation
create_aot_module: create a compiled nn.Module that lifts parameters and buffers as inputs and compiles forward and backward graphs
create_aot_module_simplified: create a low-overhead compiled module for Dynamo with no pytree overhead or caching
create_aot_export_module: create an exported FX graph from an nn.Module with optional joint forward-backward tracing and metadata
create_aot_export_joint_simple: create a simplified exported joint forward-backward FX graph with no calling convention changes
